_instructions: Merge each locale object into that locale's messages file under the key path donate.bank.*. Account numbers, IBAN, BIC and account holder names are NOT translatable: keep them in a shared constant (bankAccounts.ts) and render identically in every locale. Locale codes below match the language switcher; map de-CH to whatever code the project uses (e.g. de-CH, de_ch, gsw).
